zh-CN.title: 官方账号启用独立 Rive 人物广场
items: 官方账号进入广场时使用独立舞台，不再加载在线用户和旧人物系统
人物使用原始 Rive 文件持续播放原地行走动画
支持即时切换四套人物皮肤，并为每个官方账号记住当前选择

en.title: Dedicated Rive character square for official accounts
items: Official accounts now enter a dedicated stage without loading online users or the legacy character system
The original Rive file continuously plays its walking-in-place animation
Four character skins can be switched instantly and remembered per official account
